purpose: Provide a versioned, deployment-specific evidence-input template for recording a qualified assessment of GDPR role relationships. The template is product- and domain-neutral and does not determine a role, lawfulness, authorization, or release outcome.

scope.current_repository_state: No customer, production deployment, or deployment-specific processing relationship is established by this repository.
scope.product_boundary: The Memory Core is a protected internal subsystem, not the product boundary.
scope.assessment_unit: One immutable proposed deployment and its documented processing relationships.

role_relationship_requirements: Record each assessed party and relationship separately; a party label, tenant, request payload, prompt, or model output cannot decide a role.
For a proposed controller or joint-controller relationship, record the documented purpose-and-means assessment and qualified review reference.
For a proposed processor or subprocessor relationship, record the documented controller relationship, instructions, and contractual evidence reference.
For a proposed recipient relationship, record the disclosed transfer or disclosure relationship and supporting evidence reference.
Record all further processors or subprocessors known for the proposed deployment, or explicitly record their unknown status as a release stop.
Any role conclusion remains deployment-specific and must be made only by the accountable party and qualified applicable review outside this repository contract.
comparison_requirements: The proposed deployment remains within the versioned intended-purpose boundary or has an accepted scoped integration decision.
Authenticated Tenant, Area, Project, Session, principal, authority, and protected-state boundaries remain immutable and cannot be inferred from assessment content.

The proposed processing relationship preserves the Protected Control Plane, Memory Transition Gate, provenance, retention, legal-hold, deletion-propagation, quarantine, rollback, audit, and Area-isolation requirements.
No external effect, processing activation, or deployment release is asserted without separately governed authority, policy, approval, evidence, and release gates.
Every unknown, missing, stale, contradictory, or unqualified deployment-specific role input remains a release stop.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned deployment-specific assessment input and traceability anchor
authority_boundary.release_authority: Only separately applicable qualified legal review, accepted governance, and protected-control release mechanisms may make a deployment-specific decision after all required evidence gates pass.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies every required field, relationship-specific evidence, and a qualified applicable-law review reference for separate governance and release evaluation.
current_blocker.next_step: Create one immutable assessment record per proposed processing relationship before any deployment-specific release decision.
